en: One row per respondent of a post-project review with ratings from 1 to 5 for schedule, cost, scope and client, and the main lesson; the overall rating, the PMO phone and a check fill in by themselves.
mt: 每个受访者每行进行项目后审查,对时间表,成本,范围和客户进行1到5的评级,并提供主要教训;整体评级,PMO电话和支票自行填写.

en: Hello {contact}, deliverable {name} of {project} is submitted for acceptance. Please check it against the agreed criteria and tell us your decision.
mt: 您好, {contact} 的交付 {name} 已提交接受.请与已同意的标准进行检查,并告诉我们您的决定.

en: Hello {contact}, please accept deliverable {name} or send your comments by {decide_by}. If something is unclear, call me and we will go through it together.
mt: 你好,请接受交付,或者在2之前发送你的评论. 如果有些东西不清楚,请打电话给我,我们一起来看看.

en: Hello {contact}, deliverable {name} has been waiting {waiting} days for your decision. Please accept it or send your comments this week.
mt: 您的决定已经等了几天. 请接受或在本周发送您的评论.

en: Hello {contact}, thank you for accepting deliverable {name} on {decided_on}. We will invoice the milestone linked to it.
mt: 谢谢您在 {decided_on} 上接受交付 {name}. 我们将会发票与之相关的里程碑.

en: Hello {contact}, thank you for the review of {name}. Your comments: {comments}. We will send a fix plan with dates within two working days.
mt: 您的评论:我们将在两天内发送一个修复计划.

en: Hello {contact}, we hold {name} for {project} on {planned}. Please confirm who will attend and tell us about any open concern before then.
mt: 你好,我们在 {planned} 待 {project} 请确认谁会参加,然后告诉我们任何未解决的问题.

en: Hello {contact}, the handover session on {item} for {project} is planned for {due}. Please confirm who attends from {to_whom}.
mt: 您好,在 {item} 的 {project} 上的交换会议计划在 {due}. 请确认谁从 {to_whom} 来参加.

en: Hello {contact}, the warranty of {project} ends on {end}. Please send any claim before then so that we can solve it in time.
mt: 您的保修期限在2日结束.请在此之前发送任何索赔,以便我们及时解决.

en: Hello {tester}, test cycle {cycle_id} ({cycle}, round {round}) on {project} starts on {date}. Please prepare {planned} cases and the test data.
mt: 您好,测试周期 {cycle_id} ({cycle},圆 {round}) 在 {project} 开始于 {date}. 请准备 {planned} 案例和测试数据.

en: Hello {owner}, closure task "{task}" on {project} is due on {due}. Please finish it and tell me when it is done.
mt: 你好,关闭任务"{task}"在{project}是由于在{due}. 请完成它,告诉我什么时候完成.

en: Hello {manager}, test cycle {cycle_id} on {project} has a pass rate of {pass_rate}, below the exit level. {failed} cases failed. Please agree the fix plan with the team.
mt: 您好,测试周期 {cycle_id} 在 {project} 有 {pass_rate} 的通过率,低于出口水平. {failed} 案例失败. 请与团队商定修复计划.

en: Hello {support_owner}, the handover pack for {service} on {project} is ready. Support starts on {start}. Please confirm that you received it.
mt: 您好, {support_owner} 已准备好 {service} 的交换包. 支持开始于 {start}. 请确认您收到了.

en: Hello {support_owner}, I am sending the access and contacts list for {service} on {project}. Please check your accounts before {start}. Handover items done: {handover_done}.
mt: 您好,我在 {project} 上发送 {service} 的访问和联系人列表. 请在 {start} 之前检查您的帐户. 交付项目完成: {handover_done}.

en: Project: {col:defects.project}. Project manager: {col:defects.manager}.
mt: 项目负责人:

en: Defect: {col:defects.title}. Severity: {col:defects.severity}. Status: {col:defects.status}. Found by {col:defects.found_by} on {col:defects.found_on}. Test case: {col:defects.test}.
mt: 缺陷: {col:defects.title}. 严重性: {col:defects.severity}. 状态: {col:defects.status}. 在 {col:defects.found_on} 发现. 测试案例: {col:defects.test}.

en: Test summary report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 测试总结报告,日期为 {set:firm}

en: To: Finance partner, telephone {col:payments.fin_phone}. Project: {col:payments.project}. Milestone {col:payments.pay_id}: {col:payments.milestone}.
mt: 致:财务合作伙伴,电话.

en: Benefits realisation report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 收益实现报告日期为 {set:firm}

en: Project closure report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 项目结束报告日期为 {set:firm}

en: {col:projects.accepted} of {col:projects.deliverables} deliverables are accepted. The test pass rate is {col:projects.pass_rate}. There are {col:projects.defects_open} open defects, of which {col:projects.crit_open} are critical.
mt: {col:projects.accepted} 的产品被接受. 测试通过率是 {col:projects.pass_rate}. 有 {col:projects.defects_open} 的公开缺陷,其中 {col:projects.crit_open} 是关键的.

en: Post-project review report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 项目后审查报告,日期为 {set:firm}

en: Main lesson: {col:ppr.lesson}.
mt: 主要的教训:

en: The check shows: {col:ppr.state}. The PMO lead, telephone {col:ppr.pmo_phone}, adds the lesson to the library so that the next project can use it.
mt: 检查显示: {col:ppr.state}.PMO领导,电话 {col:ppr.pmo_phone},将课程添加到库中,以便下一个项目可以使用它.

en: Project: {col:warranty.project}. Client contact: {col:warranty.contact}, telephone {col:warranty.client_phone}.
mt: 项目:客户联系人:电话:

en: Scope covered: {col:warranty.scope}. The warranty runs from {col:warranty.start} to {col:warranty.end}. {col:warranty.days_left} days are left and {col:warranty.used} of the period is used.
mt: 覆盖范围: {col:warranty.scope}.保证期限为 {col:warranty.start} 至 {col:warranty.end}.

en: {col:warranty.claims} claim(s) were made so far. The warranty check shows: {col:warranty.state}.
